text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a meta-analysis review paper synthesizing existing studies on the impacts of agricultural land conversion on ecosystem services worldwide. It is not a primary research paper focused on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation at national scale. The study does not implement spatial modeling with future scenarios or provide mapped LULC projections. Instead, it reviews and quantitatively synthesizes existing observational studies on ecosystem service losses related to land conversion. Therefore, it is a review article not focused on LULC future prediction and does not meet core inclusion criteria.)
